name: Vizianagaram

queries.query: Vizianagaram Andhra Pradesh official cadastral parcel map land records GIS MeeBhoomi
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Vizianagaram District Collectorate revenue page, district Survey, Settlements and Land Records page, Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha cadastral-map portal, district official-links page, and Government of India DILRMP state listing. The district revenue page identifies the local revenue/survey custodian and directs users to MeeBhoomi for Adangal, ROR, FMB and village maps. No open parcel feature response was obtained.
